description.en_US: Create a clone that does a punch attack before going dormant. The clone will wait for you to use another wave combat art and then join in.

name.ja_JP: フェアリーストリーム

description.en_US: Shoots three fast projectiles that pierce through enemies. \c[3]Verdant Echoes\c[0] will also shoot at any enemies you hit.
Aim and shoot a fast projectile that explodes on hit. \c[3]Verdant Echoes\c[0] will be absorbed to power up the explosion.
Shoot a wide projectile that stuns enemies as it passes. \c[3]Verdant Echoes\c[0] will each shoot a weaker one in parallel.
Shoot an explosive bomb from the air. \c[3]Verdant Echoes\c[0] will shoot smaller projectiles towards the impact position.
